item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las lus sbyin 'khrul pa rtsad gcod
item.coloph: ces bdag 'dzin rtsad gcod gsang bdag dpa' bo dgyes pa'i gad rgyang 'di nyid gnad kyi gdams pa spel ba'i dus la slebs pa yin pas/ phyir nyin sngags gdams dpal sdis nas yang yang bskal ba la bsten (brten) nas/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po 'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal/ bla ma'i ming 'dzin g.yung drung grags pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du 'bod pa bdag gis kun rigs zhe dgu'i thun 'tshams (mtshams) su spel ba 'di ('dis) kyang / srid gsum dbang du bsdud cing sde brgyad bran du 'khor ba'i rgyur gyur cig/
